text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**The wins:**
Reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week from post-call admin. CRM notes became consistent, so handoffs to solutions engineers stopped losing context.

**The surprises:**
Customers cared less about the tool than we expected. A quick "mind if we record?" took ten seconds and almost never got a no.

**The misses:**
Summaries missed nuance. Sarcasm, hesitation, and "we'll see" were logged as agreement. Reps still had to add their own read of the deal.

**The takeaway:**
AI captures what was said. Reps still own what it meant.

We're keeping the pilot going, with a rule: every summary gets a one-line human take.

What has your team learned from AI in the field?
